messages:
Aviya Sato: hey everyone :wave: — I'm Aviya, joining infra (runtime optimizations). remote from Tokyo (JST). big fan of tiny succulents, terrible novelty mugs, and matcha. excited to meet y'all! quick q: what times should I expect synchronous overlap with the US? 

Mike L: welcome aboard Aviya!! :tada: most cross-team meetings land around 1–3pm JST but everything's pretty async. also +1 to novelty mug pics :coffee: 

Tara Li: hihi :wave: i'm in SG and can vouch for the async flow. if you want coworking recs in Shibuya i have a short list — DM me. 

Ben R: hey Aviya — fyi we ship welcome snack boxes from SF sometimes, ops handles international. ping @OpsBot with your address if you want one. :package: 

Aviya Sato: oh fun — I'll DM OpsBot the address. thanks! also curious re: infra team standups — are those weekly or skip-a-week? 

Katie M: infra standups are weekly, but you only need to join if you have updates. otherwise async notes in the #infra-updates thread. 

Sam G: :cat: also if you have any pet pics drop them here. we have a pretty strong unofficial 'pets and keyboards' culture. 

OpsBot: Welcome kit status: shipped to Aviya Sato — tracking #PKG4287. Estimated delivery: 3–7 business days. 

Mike L: small onboarding tip: add your timezone to your profile and set your working hours. helps with async handoffs. 

Tara Li: pro coworking recs: 'Book & Brew' (quiet), 'LoopWorks' (fast wifi, 1-min from Shibuya station), and a tiny rooftop cafe if you want sunshine. 

Ben R: if you want a mug, i have an embarrassing mug collection. trade for a plant? ; ) 

Aviya Sato: deal. sending mug pic in DM :smile: Looking forward to meeting folks — i'll probably pop into a few meetings the first week to say hi live. thanks for the warm welcomes! 

Everyone: :heart: :wave: :coffee:
